ClassRegistrationSystem.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the instance with an empty student list and an empty student registration mapping." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create the instance attribute students and initialize it to an empty list. RESULT self.students]
            [COMMAND Create the instance attribute students_registration_classes and initialize it to an empty dictionary. RESULT self.students_registration_classes]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ClassRegistrationSystem.register_student:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Registers a student only if they are not already present, returning 0 when already registered and 1 when newly added." register_student]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> student </REF>: unknown "The student value to register."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: int "Returns 0 if the student is already in the collection; otherwise appends the student and returns 1."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether student is already present in self.students. RESULT membership_check]
            [COMMAND If the student is already present, return 0 immediately. RESULT 0]
            [COMMAND Otherwise append the student to self.students. RESULT updated_students]
            [COMMAND Return 1 to indicate the student was newly added. RESULT 1]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ClassRegistrationSystem.register_class:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Adds a class to an existing student's registered class list or creates a new list for a new student, then returns that student's updated class list." register_class]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> student_name </REF>: any "Student identifier used as the dictionary key."
        <REF> class_name </REF>: any "Class identifier to add to the student's registration list."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: list "The updated list of classes registered for the given student."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether student_name exists as a key in self.students_registration_classes. RESULT membership_check]
            [COMMAND If student_name is already registered, append class_name to self.students_registration_classes[student_name]. RESULT updated_existing_list]
            [COMMAND If student_name is not registered, create self.students_registration_classes[student_name] with a new one-item list containing class_name. RESULT created_new_list]
            [COMMAND Return self.students_registration_classes[student_name]. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ClassRegistrationSystem.get_students_by_:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Return a list of student names whose major exactly matches the requested major." get_students_by_major]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The instance containing the students collection."
        <REF> major </REF>: any "The major value to match exactly against each student record."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: list "A list of names for students whose major equals the requested major."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty list named student_list. RESULT student_list]
            [COMMAND For each student in self.students, check whether student["major"] exactly equals major. RESULT matching_student]
            [COMMAND Within the loop, if the major matches, append student["name"] to student_list. RESULT student_list]
            [COMMAND After all students are processed, return student_list. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ClassRegistrationSystem.get_all_major:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Build a list of unique student majors from self.students in first-seen order." get_all_major]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: list "A list of unique majors preserved in the order of first appearance."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty list named major_list. RESULT major_list]
            [COMMAND Iterate through each student in self.students. RESULT student]
            [COMMAND Within the loop, check whether student["major"] is not already in major_list. RESULT uniqueness_check]
            [COMMAND Within the loop, if the major is absent, append student["major"] to major_list. RESULT major_list]
            [COMMAND Return major_list after processing all students. RESULT major_list]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ClassRegistrationSystem.get_most_popular:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Collect the registered classes of all students whose major matches the input major and return the class that appears most frequently among them." get_most_popular_class_in_major]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> major </REF>: data_type "The target major value used to filter students by exact match against student['major']."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> most_popular_class </REF>: data_type "The class value with the highest occurrence count among the registered classes of students in the specified major."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize class_list as an empty list to accumulate classes from students in the specified major. RESULT class_list]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each student in self.students. RESULT student]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over self.students, if student["major"] is exactly equal to major, extend class_list with the sequence from self.students_registration_classes indexed by student["name"]. RESULT class_list]
            [COMMAND Compute the unique candidate classes as set(class_list), then select the element with the maximum class_list.count value and assign it to most_popular_class. RESULT most_popular_class]
            [COMMAND Return most_popular_class. RESULT return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: The collected class_list is empty when evaluating max(set(class_list), key=class_list.count).]
        [LOG "max() is called on an empty set because no classes were collected for the specified major."]
        [THROW ValueError "Raised when max() receives an empty iterable because no matching students or no registered classes were collected."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
